```python
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

# Parse the XML response
tree = ET.parse('arxiv_response.xml')
root = tree.getroot()

# Define namespaces
ns = {
    'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom',
    'arxiv': 'http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom'
}

entries = root.findall('atom:entry', ns)
print(f"Found {len(entries)} papers")

papers = []
for entry in entries:
    title_elem = entry.find('atom:title', ns)
    title = ' '.join(title_elem.text.split()) if title_elem is not None else 'N/A'
    
    summary_elem = entry.find('atom:summary', ns)
    summary = ' '.join(summary_elem.text.split()) if summary_elem is not None else 'N/A'
    
    published_elem = entry.find('atom:published', ns)
    published = published_elem.text if published_elem is not None else 'N/A'
    
    id_elem = entry.find('atom:id', ns)
    paper_id = id_elem.text if id_elem is not None else 'N/A'
    
    # Get authors
    authors = []
    for author_elem in entry.findall('atom:author', ns):
        name_elem = author_elem.find('atom:name', ns)
        if name_elem is not None:
            authors.append(name_elem.text)
    
    papers.append({
        'id': paper_id,
        'title': title,
        'summary': summary,
        'published': published,
        'authors': authors
    })

# Print summary of all papers found
for i, p in enumerate(papers):
    print(f"\n--- Paper {i+1} ---")
    print(f"Title: {p['title']}")
    print(f"ID: {p['id']}")
    print(f"Published: {p['published']}")
    print(f"Authors: {', '.join(p['authors'][:3])}{'...' if len(p['authors']) > 3 else ''}")
    print(f"Summary (first 200 chars): {p['summary'][:200]}")
```

```python
# Let me thoroughly examine each paper's abstract to select the 5 best ones
# I'll categorize them based on relevance to multimodal RAG

paper_analyses = []
for i, p in enumerate(papers_data):
    abstract_lower = p['abstract'].lower()
    relevance_indicators = {
        'multimodal': 'multimodal' in abstract_lower,
        'retrieval': 'retrieval' in abstract_lower,
        'generation': 'generation' in abstract_lower,
        'rag': 'rag' in abstract_lower or 'retrieval-augmented' in abstract_lower,
        'vision': 'vision' in abstract_lower or 'image' in abstract_lower,
        'audio': 'audio' in abstract_lower or 'speech' in abstract_lower,
        'video': 'video' in abstract_lower,
        'text': 'text' in abstract_lower,
        'knowledge': 'knowledge' in abstract_lower or 'document' in abstract_lower
    }
    score = sum(relevance_indicators.values())
    paper_analyses.append({
        'index': i,
        'paper': p,
        'indicators': relevance_indicators,
        'relevance_score': score
    })
    
    print(f"\nPaper {i+1}: {p['title'][:80]}")
    print(f"  Relevance score: {score}")
    print(f"  Indicators: { {k:v for k,v in relevance_indicators.items() if v} }")

# Sort by relevance score
paper_analyses.sort(key=lambda x: x['relevance_score'], reverse=True)
print(f"\n\nTop 5 most relevant papers:")
for rank, pa in enumerate(paper_analyses[:5], 1):
    print(f"  {rank}. {pa['paper']['title'][:80]} (score: {pa['relevance_score']})")
```
